summary.description: One or two short sentences in plain English for a busy parent: what the request is and what you think of it.

decided.description: Points the owner has settled in their answers to earlier idea checks, one short line each. Empty if none.

findings.description: Problems with the idea. Empty if it is clear and fits the rules.

detail.description: For a question: the question to the owner, with the options if there are any. Otherwise: what is wrong and what you suggest, naming the rule or decision (e.g. D14).
